thesis: The page is the coat schedule: every section is one numbered step in the crew's process, stamped with its dry time and layered under a film-build stripe that thickens as you scroll.

signature.name: Coat Schedule Stripe
signature.summary: Left-edge vertical stripe representing cumulative film build; each section adds one translucent layer, numbered 00-06 with dry-time stamps. Stripe thickens via --sw-p scroll variable.

motion.intro: Painter's tape pulls horizontally across h1 to reveal headline (clip-path wipe, 900ms, skippable)
